heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: When drilling speed is too fast, it results in:

options.A: The hole will be too deep
options.B: The drill bit will get struck and break
options.D: The drill bit will fail due to centrifugal forces

explanation: Excessive drilling speed generates high frictional heat, which softens the cutting edges of the drill bit and rapidly dulls it.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: Taper, plug and bottoming are types of:
explanation: Taper, plug, and bottoming are the three standard styles of hand taps used for cutting internal threads.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: When using a file properly:

options.B: Apply force on the back stroke
options.D: Apply force on the forward stroke only

explanation: Downward and forward pressure should be applied only on the forward cutting stroke, easing pressure or lifting slightly on the return stroke to prevent dulling the teeth.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: In order to check the trueness of a flat surface, one would use a:
explanation: A precision surface plate provides an accurate reference plane used in conjunction with blueing or dial indicators to test surface flatness.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: The tap drill is always smaller than the tap so as to leave sufficient material for the tap to produce _____ percent of the full thread.
explanation: Standard tap drill charts are sized to leave enough material to cut approximately 75 percent of full thread depth, providing optimal fastener strength without overloading the tap.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: Cracked grinding wheels:

options.A: Should be kept in a special toolbox
options.B: Should be replace under their "lifetime" warranty
options.C: Must be used carefully and cautiously if injury is to be prevented
options.E: Should be of no concern to the user

explanation: Cracked grinding wheels are structurally compromised and can shatter catastrophically under centrifugal force; they must be discarded immediately.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: A tap with the marking M4 would indicate a:

options.B: Metric thread, 4 cm nominal diameter of the thread
options.C: Metric thread, 4 mm nominal diameter of the thread

explanation: The 'M' designation denotes an ISO metric thread, and the number 4 specifies a nominal major diameter of 4 millimeters.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: An important safety check when using any grinder is to ensure:

options.A: The grinder is designed for right handed people

explanation: Verifying that the grinder RPM does not exceed the maximum safe operating speed rating of the grinding wheel is vital to prevent wheel explosion.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: Micrometers are available in a variety of types and are used mainly for the measurement of:

options.A: The density of the boiler flue gases for pollution control
options.B: Outside, inside, and depth dimensions of relatively small openings of objects
options.C: Vertical, perpendicular and parallel distances in assembly of power plant machines
options.D: Length, width, and thickness of the boiler house structure

explanation: Micrometers are high-precision measuring instruments designed to measure outside dimensions, inside dimensions, and depth with extreme accuracy.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: Copper sulphate may be used:

options.B: For lubricating very fine threads such as those in a micrometer
options.C: Coating tools in order to prevent rusting
options.D: To free nuts which are corroded to bolts

explanation: Copper sulphate solution (layout dye) is brushed onto metal surfaces to leave a thin copper coating that highlights scribed layout lines.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: Whatever the size of a micrometer, the working parts can only move a distance of:
explanation: Standard micrometer spindles have a travel range of 25 mm (or 1 inch), requiring different frame sizes for larger dimension measurements.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: Chalk or _____ may be used to rub on the surface of rough castings as a marking material.
explanation: Soapstone or chalk is ideal for marking rough castings or dark surfaces where standard layout dye is ineffective.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: A screwdriver having a square tip is known as:
explanation: A Robertson screwdriver features a distinctive square tapered tip designed to fit snugly into matching square socket screws.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: Pipe wrenches should not be used on:
explanation: Pipe wrench jaws have hardened, serrated teeth that bite into metal and will severely damage nuts, bolts, and finished machine surfaces.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: Adjustable wrenches should only be used:

options.A: With the turning force applied to the fixed jaw
options.D: With the turning force applied to the moving jaw

explanation: Pulling so that force is applied against the stationary/fixed jaw prevents the adjustable jaw from springing open and slipping off the fastener.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: A dressing tool is used to:

options.A: Fit a new handle into a hammer head
options.B: Square the edges of a grinding wheel
options.C: Re-set the teeth of a saw
options.D: Clean the measuring contact surfaces of a micrometer
options.E: Clean the grooves of a file

explanation: A wheel dresser is used to clean loading, true out unbalance, and square the edges or face of a grinding wheel.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: When drilling in metal it is important to:
explanation: Center punching provides an indentation that guides the drill point and prevents it from wandering or walking across the metal surface.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: A collet is:

options.A: A type of face spanner wrench
options.C: Used to make a square hole in a piece of plate
options.D: A holder for an adjustable thread die
options.E: The moving part of a micrometer

explanation: In tool and threading applications, a collet or die stock holder is used to securely hold and turn adjustable circular thread-cutting dies.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: The correct tool to tighten fasteners to the correct tightness on bearing caps is:
explanation: A torque wrench is required to tighten critical fasteners such as bearing cap bolts to exact manufacturer torque specifications.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance I
question: A file which is always single cut is the:
explanation: Mill files feature a single row of parallel teeth (single cut) designed for smooth finishing and sharpening applications.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: Wire rope classified as 8 x 12 means it has:

options.A: A factor of safety of 8 and is 12 metres long
options.D: A factor of safety of 12 and is 8 metres long

explanation: In wire rope classification, the first number denotes the number of strands, and the second number denotes the number of individual wires per strand.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: When a ladder is found to be defective it must be removed from service and:

options.B: Safety tag affixed to not use
options.E: Used only for low level work

explanation: When a ladder is found to be defective, it must be immediately removed from service and clearly tagged with a 'DO NOT USE' or 'DANGER' safety tag. This warns workers not to use the ladder accidentally. The ladder must remain out of service until it is properly repaired and inspected or safely disposed of.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: Prior to hoisting an object it is very important to:
explanation: Knowing or accurately calculating the mass/weight of the load is a mandatory prerequisite to select correct rigging equipment and ensure crane capacity limits are not exceeded.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: A single pole scaffold:

options.A: Is free standing from the building
options.D: Places no load on the building
options.E: Is partially supported by a building

explanation: A single-pole scaffold is supported by a single row of uprights/poles on the outside and is tied to or partially supported by the structure or building on the inside.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: Platforms should have a _____ edge going around them to prevent objects from rolling off.
explanation: Platforms and scaffolding decks require toe boards or raised edges to prevent tools, materials, and debris from rolling or sliding off and striking personnel below.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: Stove bolt nuts are usually:
explanation: Stove bolts are commonly paired with square nuts for general assembly applications.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: An M24 coarse thread bolt has:
explanation: According to ISO metric coarse thread standards, an M24 bolt has a standard thread pitch of 3 mm. Thread pitch is the distance between two adjacent threads, measured in millimetres. This means the distance from one thread to the next is 3 mm. Remember: M24 represents a nominal bolt diameter of 24 mm, while 3 mm represents the thread pitch.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: A rung ladder should:

options.A: Always have at least one rail touching the support
options.C: Never be able to conduct electricity
options.E: Not be equipped with rubber feet, only metal ones

explanation: Portable extension and straight ladders must be set up at a safe inclination ratio of 4:1 (one horizontal unit out for every four vertical units up).

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: Ladders constructed on the job must comply with the:
explanation: Job-built ladders must strictly follow construction specifications outlined in local Workers' Compensation Board (WCB) regulations or occupational health and safety codes.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: The top of a ladder should extend approximately _____ above the level of the upper landing to which it provides access.
explanation: A portable ladder should extend approximately 1.0 metre (1000 mm) above the upper landing it provides access to. This extra length gives workers a secure handhold when climbing on or off the ladder, reducing the risk of slipping or falling. Remember: the ladder should extend about 1 metre above the landing.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: A government agency that covers several aspects of work platforms is the:
explanation: Workers' Compensation Board (WCB) or provincial occupational health and safety regulations govern scaffolding, staging, and elevated work platform safety.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: To prevent damage to a work surface while fastening with bolts:

options.E: Use a lubricant during threading and tightening

explanation: Flat washers distribute the clamping load over a larger surface area, preventing the bolt head or nut from marring or crushing the underlying material.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: A yellow scaffold tag indicates:

options.A: The scaffold is safe to use but there are hazards
options.C: The scaffold is almost unsafe to use
options.D: The scaffold is only safe for 1 person at a time

explanation: A yellow scaffold tag serves as a caution warning that the scaffold is functional and safe to use under specific conditions or with mandatory personal fall arrest equipment due to potential hazards.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: The maximum percentage error we should use when calculating the mass of a light object is:
explanation: When calculating the mass of a light object for lifting or rigging, the maximum allowable percentage error is 20%. This means the calculated mass may differ from the actual mass by up to 20%. Accurate load calculations are important to ensure the lifting equipment is not overloaded and the lift is performed safely.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: A knot used to pull at right angles to a pipe or pole is the:

options.E: Round turn and two half hitches

explanation: A clove hitch is exceptionally effective for securing a rope perpendicularly around cylindrical objects like pipes, posts, or poles for pulling.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: An eye made by using a Crosby clip will have a strength factor of:
explanation: Properly installed wire rope clip (Crosby clip) terminations retain approximately 80% of the wire rope's nominal breaking strength.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: When using a step ladder it is best to:

options.A: Have two co-workers hold the ladder steady
options.B: Have a 4:1 slope on the rung side
options.C: Place both feet on the top platform if extra height is required
options.D: Secure the ladder with a rope
options.E: Not work higher than the top three rungs

explanation: For stability and fall prevention, workers should never stand on or work from the top cap or top two/three steps of a stepladder.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: When working on a platform it is important to:

options.B: Warn people on the ground of hazards
options.C: Notify the applicable government agency of usage
options.E: Ensure the harness is attached to the scaffold

explanation: Protecting workers and personnel below by warning them of overhead work, falling object hazards, or dropped tools is a critical safety requirement.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: Electricians prefer fiberglass ladders because:
explanation: Fiberglass is a non-conductive composite material, making fiberglass ladders the mandatory choice for electrical work to prevent electrocution hazards.

heading: Energy Plant Maintenance II
question: Castle nuts are used:

options.C: For locking square nuts in place
options.D: To lock the bolt in place

explanation: Castle nuts feature slotted notches on top designed to accommodate a cotter pin (split pin) passing through a drilled bolt hole to lock the fastener securely against vibration.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question:
When working inside a steel heating boiler, which of the following safety precautions should you take?
1. The boiler must be cooled and vented
2. The valves must be closed and locked and all lines to and from the boiler must be blanked
3. You may use ungrounded wiring
4. Always have one worker standing outside whenever anyone is inside the boiler
explanation: When entering a boiler (a confined space), the vessel must be properly cooled and vented, all isolation valves locked out and lines blanked, and a standby safety watch positioned outside. Ungrounded wiring is extremely dangerous and strictly prohibited.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: Before a welder is allowed to weld on a boiler, he must have a:

options.A: Certain minimum number of years of experience
options.E: Certificate of qualification and a performance qualification card

explanation: Pressure welding on boilers and pressure vessels requires the welder to possess both a valid Certificate of Qualification and a Performance Qualification Card for the specific welding procedure.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: Laying up a boiler means:

options.A: Preparing the boiler for a period of storage
options.B: Preparing a boiler for start up
options.D: Setting the boiler on its foundation
options.E: Taking the boiler down for an annual overhaul

explanation: Laying up a boiler refers to taking it out of service and preparing it for a period of short-term or long-term storage (either wet or dry) to protect against corrosion.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: A black light crack detection utilises ultraviolet light and:
explanation: Fluorescent penetrant inspection (a type of liquid penetrant testing) uses a fluorescent dye penetrant that glows under ultraviolet (black) light to reveal surface-breaking cracks.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: A steam heating boiler that is to be shut down for six months during the summer should be:

options.A: Drained, thoroughly dried out, quick lime placed inside and left open
options.B: Drained, thoroughly dried out, quick lime placed inside and closed up
options.C: Left with the water at normal working level but opened up to atmosphere
options.D: Left with the water at normal working level and pressurised with air to 50 kPa
options.E: Filled completely with water and the vent left open to atmosphere

explanation: For a 6-month seasonal shutdown (dry layup), the boiler is completely drained, dried out, a desiccant such as quicklime (calcium oxide) is placed inside to absorb moisture, and the vessel is sealed tight.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: A water tank should be installed above the boiler and attached to the vent connection during a wet lay up in order to:

options.A: Prevent water vapour from entering the power plant
options.C: Prevent air from entering the boiler during water contraction

explanation: During wet layup, an overhead surge/expansion tank attached to the vent maintains a positive head of treated water to prevent air (oxygen) from drawing into the boiler as water cools and contracts.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: The boiler operator should be alert for steam leaks in connections because if a leak was to persist for any length of time, it may result in:

options.A: Loss of steam and reduced efficiency
options.C: The accumulation of salt deposits around the leak
options.D: A reduction in the condensate returns
options.E: Water damage due to the condensing steam

explanation: Persistent steam leaks cause wire-drawing and high-velocity erosion (flute cutting) on metal flange faces, gasket seating surfaces, and valve seats.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: When the fireside of a boiler is first opened up, small leak seepage spots can be detected by:

options.C: White salt deposits resulting from water evaporation

explanation: When water evaporates from small tube/joint seepage spots on a cold fireside, it leaves behind noticeable white crusty salt deposits (boiler water treatment solids).

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: Boiler furnace refractory should be _____ to prolong its life.

options.E: Wash coated with a dilute solution of heat resistant cement

explanation: Applying a wash coat of dilute high-temperature heat-resistant refractory cement helps seal fine surface cracks and extend the operating life of boiler furnace refractory.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: It is recommended that a new boiler be shut down, drained, opened up, flushed out and inspected after the first _____ months of operation.
explanation: Standard power engineering recommendations specify that a newly commissioned boiler should be shut down, drained, opened, flushed, and thoroughly inspected after its initial 3 months of operation.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: Who should be responsible for doing frequent boiler inspections?
explanation: The certified steam plant operator on duty is directly responsible for carrying out routine daily, weekly, and frequent operational checks and visual inspections of the boiler.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: The final step in replacing a firetube is:

options.A: Firing the boiler up to normal working pressure
options.C: Filling the boiler with water and checking for leaks

explanation: After replacing a firetube, expanding, and beading the tube ends, a hydrostatic pressure test is applied as the final verification of seal tightness before returning the boiler to service.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: A substance that will absorb humidity inside a boiler during dry lay up is:
explanation: Activated alumina (or quicklime/silica gel) is a highly effective desiccant used inside boiler drums during dry layup to absorb atmospheric humidity and prevent corrosion.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: The interior of firetubes are cleaned to remove deposits of:
explanation: Firetubes carry hot combustion gases inside the tubes; their internal surfaces must be periodically brushed or blown to clean out accumulated soot deposits.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: Boilers that are maintained on hot standby should be:

options.A: Left with a fire in the furnace
options.B: Dried out on the water side

explanation: Boilers maintained on hot standby should be steam capped. This means maintaining a small positive steam pressure inside the boiler to prevent air (oxygen) from entering. Oxygen can cause corrosion of the boiler's internal metal surfaces. Steam capping also keeps the boiler warm and ready for a quick restart when needed.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: A tube beading tool is used:

options.B: To unfasten fire tubes from the tube sheet
options.D: To fasten the stays in the tube sheet

explanation: A tube beading tool is used on firetube boilers to curl and bead the protruding ends of firetubes tightly against the tube sheet after expanding.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: A boiler circulating pump gland should have some leakage:

options.A: In order to keep the motor amperage down
options.B: To prevent the packing from drying out
options.C: So that the shaft sleeve will take the wear
options.D: In order for the stuffing box to run at the desired high temperature
options.E: So the operator can tell when the pump becomes vapour bound

explanation: A packed stuffing box gland on a centrifugal pump requires a slight continuous leakage of liquid to lubricate and cool the packing rings, preventing them from drying out and scorching the shaft.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: A tube expander is used for:
explanation: A mechanical roller tube expander is used to expand the outside diameter of a tube end snugly against the tube sheet hole to create a pressure-tight, leak-proof mechanical joint.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: When plugging off a tube in a boiler, the plug taper should be:
explanation: When plugging off a boiler tube, the plug should have a taper of 20 to 1. This gradual taper allows the plug to fit tightly inside the tube when driven into position, creating a secure seal and preventing water or steam leakage.

heading: Boiler Maintenance
question: Fire tube failures failure occurs due to all of these except:
explanation: Over-firing, waterside/fireside corrosion, poor water circulation, and inadequate water treatment cause tube failure. Routine inspection is a preventative safety practice, not a cause of failure.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A hydrostatic test on a high pressure steam boiler:

options.A: Will test the high pressure steam fuel cut off
options.B: Must only be done by the inspector
options.C: Must be done according to jurisdictional regulations
options.D: Must be done before every start up of a boiler
options.E: Should be done with the Chief Engineer present

explanation: Hydrostatic testing must strictly comply with jurisdictional regulations and ASME code guidelines governing test pressure, water temperature, and safety precautions.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: One of the legal responsibilities of the engineer during an inspection is:

options.A: To notify the Workers' Compensation Board of the inspection
options.B: To be in possession of an inspection certificate
options.C: To allow the inspector onto the premises, but only during working hours
options.D: Point out any known or suspected defects to the inspector
options.E: To have at least two staff members present at all times

explanation: Power engineering regulations legally obligate the operating engineer or owner to point out any known or suspected defects, cracks, or leaks to the boiler inspector.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: What is the water pressure a boiler is subject to when a hydrostatic test is being carried out?

options.D: 2 times the setting of the lowest set safety valve

explanation: A standard hydrostatic pressure test on a boiler is carried out at 1.5 times (1 1/2 times) the maximum allowable working pressure (MAWP) or lowest safety valve setting.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: When the boiler is removed from service, it can be drained once the temperature reaches approximately:
explanation: When a boiler is removed from service, it should be allowed to cool before draining. The water temperature should reach approximately 90°C before draining. This helps reduce the risk of thermal shock, sudden temperature changes, and damage to boiler components. Remember: Allow the boiler to cool to approximately 90°C before draining.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: An inhibitor, when added to acid will:

options.A: Make the acid compatible with the sewer system for disposal
options.C: Strengthen the acid thereby shortening the cleaning procedure
options.D: Prevent the acid from attacking the boiler metal
options.E: Minimise the effect the acid has on the metal

explanation: Inhibitors are chemical agents added to acid cleaning solutions to minimize or prevent acid attack on the bare parent metal of the boiler while allowing scale dissolution.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A boiler inspection:

options.A: Is done with the owners permission only
options.B: Is only required after a boiler has been operating 3 years
options.C: Must be done whenever the boiler inspector requests it
options.D: Is only required if an accident occurs
options.E: Must be done after every shut down of the boiler

explanation: A boiler inspection is a legal requirement and must be granted whenever requested by an authorized jurisdictional boiler inspector.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: External inspection includes:

options.A: Inspect all auxiliary equipment and pressure vessels
options.B: Check the plant records, log books, etc
options.C: Check the operation of each safety shutdown device

explanation: An external inspection while the boiler is in operation encompasses checking auxiliary equipment, reviewing logbooks, testing safety shutdown devices, and observing overall maintenance practices.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: Just before entering the waterside of the boiler it is important to:

options.A: Obtain permission to do so from plant management
options.B: Ensure the Chief Engineer is aware of your intent
options.C: Notify the inspector in writing of your intent to do so
options.D: Be wearing self-contained breathing apparatus SCBA

explanation: Prior to entering the drum or waterside of a boiler (confined space), atmospheric testing for oxygen levels and toxic/flammable gases is mandatory.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: Before cleaning the waterside and as far as is possible:

options.B: A scale sample should be taken and an analysis done
options.C: All drum internals should be removed
options.D: Mud drum sludge should be completely removed
options.E: A visual inspection of pressure parts should be completed

explanation: Before washing or cleaning away deposits on the waterside, a thorough preliminary visual inspection of internal pressure parts should be completed to document baseline condition and scale buildup.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: The most popular acid for boiler cleaning is:
explanation: Inhibited hydrochloric acid is the most widely used and cost-effective acid for chemical cleaning of industrial boilers.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: Chemical cleaning of smaller boilers is not usually done because:

options.A: They do not have adequate support for the high density of the chemicals
options.B: Of the small surface area which the chemical contacts
options.C: It is impossible to get the chemical circulating adequately
options.D: Of the thin metal of which they are manufactured
options.E: The cost to do so is not warranted or justified

explanation: Chemical cleaning requires specialized pumps, piping, neutralizing steps, and chemical disposal; for smaller boilers, the financial cost is rarely justified compared to mechanical cleaning.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: The recommended procedures for a boiler inspection are stated in the:

options.A: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section I
options.C: CSA B51 Boiler Pressure Vessel and Pressure Piping Code
options.D: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section VII
options.E: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section IV

explanation: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section VII provides recommended guidelines and procedures for the care, maintenance, and inspection of power boilers.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A relatively safer chemical used in boiler cleaning and treatment is:
explanation: Chelates (chelating agents like EDTA and NTA) are relatively safe, less corrosive organic chemicals used for continuous or periodic cleaning and scale removal compared to mineral acids.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: For an alkaline boil out, the boiler is maintained at a desired steam pressure for about:
explanation: During an alkaline boil-out, the boiler is filled with water containing alkaline cleaning chemicals, such as caustic soda and trisodium phosphate. The boiler is heated and maintained at the required steam pressure for approximately 48 hours. This allows the chemicals enough time to loosen and remove oil, grease, and other manufacturing residues from the boiler's internal surfaces. Remember: Alkaline boil-out = 48 hours (2 days).

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: When cooling down a steam boiler that has been taken out of service, a vent valve on the steam drum should be opened to prevent a vacuum at:
explanation: When cooling a boiler, the drum vent valve is opened when pressure drops to approximately 175 kPa (or 15-20 psi) to prevent creating a atmospheric vacuum inside the vessel.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: The external inspection of a boiler:

options.A: May include making sure the furnace refractory is in order
options.B: May include making sure the exterior of the tubes are in good condition
options.C: Must be done after the boiler has been drained
options.D: May include making sure the tubes are free of scale
options.E: May include making sure the valves are in good operating condition

explanation: An external inspection is conducted while the boiler is operating and includes checking the external condition and operational readiness of valves, controls, and fittings.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A boiler has been in operation for one year and is now taken off the line for cleaning, repair and inspection. The boiler is one of three in a battery and the other two will remain in operation. This one boiler is to be drained and cooled. Before any person is allowed to enter the boiler drum, the correct safety procedure requires that the:

options.A: Main steam, blow down, blow off, and feedwater valves be closed, chained and tagged
options.B: Person is equipped with the correct kind of tools and a list of required repairs
options.C: Worker is provided with a safety kit for confined space entry
options.D: Worker is provided with a safety line, first aid kit, and hard hat
options.E: Drum be vented, the safety valve gagged, and all ashes and soot removed from the fire box

explanation: When a boiler is part of a battery with common headers, all connected steam, blowdown, and feedwater isolation valves must be securely closed, locked/chained, and tagged out (and preferably blanked) before drum entry.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A hydrostatic test should be applied to a boiler:

options.A: At the request of the owner
options.C: At the request of the boiler inspector

explanation: A hydrostatic test is performed after major pressure component repairs or whenever explicitly requested by the authorized boiler inspector.
